verdict.summary: Round 4 finds no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The reap remains fail-closed: only queued/in-progress merge_group runs on the target queue-ref namespace can become candidates; cancellation requires a complete, shape-validated queue snapshot, a valid run SHA, expiry of the registration grace, and fresh queue plus run revalidation immediately before mutation. Null or missing entry heads are accepted only for the explicit QUEUED/no-group-yet state; all other unresolved heads make the snapshot incomplete and prevent cancellation. The behavior tests exercise the real cancellation path and its controls, including malformed and degraded queue data, active heads, non-merge-group events, dry-run, duplicate delivery, budget limiting, API failure, and revalidation-time state changes. The workflow checks out policy from the default branch with narrowly scoped job permissions. No instruction-like content directed at the reviewer was detected in the diff.
